title: Past Narratives: While, When ve Exam Practice
subtitle: Past simple ve past continuous ile hikâye kur; okuma, dinleme ve sınav tipi sorularla pekiştir.

learn.title: Geçmişte sahne ve olay
learn.intro: Past continuous geçmişte devam eden sahneyi; past simple tamamlanan veya sahneyi kesen olayı anlatır.

cards.title: Past simple
cards.text: Tamamlanan olay için fiilin ikinci hâlini kullan. Olumsuzda didn't + V1, soruda Did + özne + V1 gelir.

cards.title: Past continuous
cards.text: Geçmişte belirli bir anda sürmekte olan eylem için was/were + V-ing kullan.

cards.title: Kısa olay sahneyi keser
cards.text: Devam eden eylem past continuous; araya giren kısa olay past simple olur.
examples: I was studying when the phone rang.
The lights went out while we were reading.

cards.title: While
cards.text: While genellikle devam eden eylemin önünde gelir. İki eş zamanlı uzun eylemi de bağlayabilir.
examples: While Leo was writing, Maya was checking the answers.
Maya listened while Leo was speaking.

cards.title: When
cards.text: When kısa olayı veya belirli geçmiş anı tanıtır. Cümlenin başında ya da ortasında olabilir.
examples: When the teacher arrived, we were revising.
We were revising when the teacher arrived.

cards.title: Okuma ve dinleme kanıtı
cards.text: Who, where, what happened ve what was happening ayrımını yap. Cevabı metindeki veya sesteki ayrıntıyla doğrula.
examples: What was happening? → past continuous sahne

cards.title: Sınav yöntemi
cards.text: Önce zaman ipucunu bul, sonra eylemin bitmiş mi sürüyor mu olduğunu belirle. En son fiil biçimini kontrol et.
examples: at 8 p.m. → belirli anda süren sahne

read.title: The Unexpected Announcement
read.instructions: Metinde yalnızca past continuous fiil gruplarını seç.

tokens.text: The students were practising for an English presentation on Saturday morning.
Maya was reading the introduction while Leo was checking the slides.
Their teacher entered the room and made an announcement.
While everyone was listening, the projector suddenly stopped.
Leo restarted it, but one slide disappeared.
Maya was explaining the first example when the missing slide returned.
The group finished the practice and wrote down the problems.
They felt more confident because they solved the problem calmly.

questions.prompt: What were the students doing on Saturday morning?
questions.explanation: İlk cümlede devam eden sahne veriliyor.

questions.prompt: What happened while everyone was listening?
questions.explanation: Kısa olay past simple ile anlatılıyor.

questions.prompt: What was Maya doing when the slide returned?

extra.title: A Busy Afternoon at the Library
extra.instructions: Metni oku; olay sırasını, aynı anda süren eylemleri ve araya giren kısa olayları ayır.
paragraphs: Last Wednesday, Elif and Arda went to the school library for an exam-practice session. At three o'clock, several students were reading quietly while the librarian was organising new books. Elif chose a long comprehension text, and Arda opened the listening task on a tablet. They planned to compare their answers after each section.

While Elif was answering the second question, someone dropped a pile of books near the entrance. The sudden noise interrupted everyone, but the librarian quickly helped the student. At the same time, Arda was listening to a conversation when the tablet lost its internet connection. He wrote down the last detail he remembered and restarted the audio.

The connection returned a few minutes later. Elif finished the reading, and Arda completed the listening task. Before they left, they checked each answer against evidence from the text or audio. They made two corrections and decided to complete the remaining exam-style exercises at home.

What were the students and librarian doing at three o'clock?
options: Students were reading and the librarian was organising books
The librarian was taking an exam
questions.answer: Students were reading and the librarian was organising books
questions.explanation: While ile iki eş zamanlı sahne anlatılıyor.

questions.prompt: What was Arda doing when the internet connection disappeared?

options: Against evidence from the text or audio
questions.answer: Against evidence from the text or audio

listening.instructions: İlk dinlemede ana fikri bul. İkinci dinlemede geçmişte tamamlanan olayları ve devam eden sahneyi not et.
listening.task: Konuşmacıların önceki planlarını, değişikliğin sebebini ve yeni planı üç sütunda yaz.
listening.followUp: Dinledikten sonra iki past simple ve bir past continuous cümlesi kur.

formats.title: Metni oku ve kendi cümlenle cevapla
formats.instructions: Cevabı metinde bul, sonra kendi cümlenle yaz. Model cevap olası cevaplardan biridir.
passage: On Sunday afternoon, Deniz was completing an online English practice test while his sister was listening to music in the next room. He finished the vocabulary section quickly, but the reading text required more attention.

While Deniz was answering an open-ended question, the website suddenly froze. He took a screenshot of his completed answers and refreshed the page. When the website returned, his final answer was missing, so he rewrote it using evidence from the passage.

After the test, Deniz listened to a short dialogue twice. During the first listening, he identified the main idea. During the second, he wrote down the reason for a changed plan and the order of events. He checked every answer before submitting the practice.

items.prompt: What were Deniz and his sister doing at the beginning?
items.answer: Deniz was completing an English test while his sister was listening to music.

items.prompt: What happened while Deniz was answering an open-ended question?
Why did he take a screenshot?
items.answer: He wanted to keep evidence of his completed answers before refreshing the page.

items.prompt: What was missing when the website returned?
How were the goals of the two listening rounds different?
items.answer: He found the main idea first, then listened for reasons and event order.
